text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Ugh, this time is awful.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It can't end yet...! A first-class 
individual wouldn't fall in a place like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Oh, King... staying up until this 
hour...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After being shown such burning passion, 
there's no way I can just cool down now!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep training! I want to find the 
limits of my toughness!
choice_data_list: That'll lead to overwork, so let's not.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nice guts, King! But... can you keep up 
with my brilliance?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of letting you see 
anything other than King's back!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, reckless effort alone won't 
conquer the world. Still, just sitting 
still feels...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you've got energy to burn, channel it 
into cheering!
